nodes.text:
The WHO has reassured the public about HMPV, a respiratory virus spreading in China, stating it is neither new nor particularly dangerous.

Chinese officials report that respiratory infections, including flu, RSV, and Covid-19, are circulating as expected in winter.

🧵1 https://t.co/SudET3R62d

nodes.author: NewsBFM
nodes.text:
WHO spokeswoman Margaret Harris said current respiratory infection levels in China are within normal winter ranges.

Chinese authorities confirm hospital usage is lower than last year, with no emergency declarations or responses triggered

The Chinese authorities added that the illnesses appear milder and less widespread than in previous years.

🧵2

nodes.author: NewsBFM
nodes.text:
Human metapneumovirus, first discovered in 2001, is a common virus that typically circulates in winter and spring.

HMPV usually causes mild cold symptoms but can lead to serious illnesses like bronchitis or pneumonia in older individuals or those with weak immune systems.
